The Ren'dorei are an organization of void elves seeking to use the powers of the Void for the sake of defending Azeroth as weapons of the Alliance. Under the leadership of Alleria Windrunner and Magister Umbric, they are based in Telogrus Rift, the fragmented remains of an ancient Void-infested world. Among their ranks, the Riftwalkers are tasked with investigating all Void activity that appears across the world.

The Reshii Ribbons ( ) are a set of at minimum four and possibly at least eleven runed ribbons from K'aresh capable of converting all forms of energy, including the Void, into arcane. One of K'aresh's greatest cultural artifacts from centuries past, the Reshii Ribbons are, themselves, imbued with arcane power. They are symbolic of the K'areshi's ties to "the ancient ways" and act as a reminder of their past.

The Riftwalkers are an order of void elves tasked with investigating all Void activity that appears on Azeroth, a vital duty given the danger posed by this dark force. The organization was brought together to protect Azeroth from the Void, and its members are determined to save the world by wielding that very power. They were rently deployed during the Ren'dorei's campaigns on K'aresh and in the Voidstorm.

Rionthus is a dracthyr located in the Onyx Laboratory in Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible. He is one of The Forgotten Experiments, created by Neltharion 20,000 years ago in his attempts to create ideal soldiers for the War of the Scaleborn. He was the 328th prototype created and was the result of a refined arcane infusion process. He appears as a dracthyr with visible patches of arcane energy, and despite considering himself a perfect creation, was declared unsatisfactory. But he was also deemed too dangerous to destroy, and was sealed in stasis until being released by the Echo of Neltharion to test several intruders.

The Rocket Tower is a structure in Warcraft Rumble. Rocket Towers are placed across the map in strategic locations, typically starting in control of the enemy AI. They are deploy zones, similar to the Barracks and Meeting Stones. Unlike the Meeting Stone, they will defend themselves when attacked and must be destroyed and rebuilt to be claimed. Though this can be a challenge, it also allows the player to set up a stable forward position on the map for themselves -- unlike Meeting Stones which can be taken by the enemy simply walking by them. , a sacredite in Siren Isle.]] The Sacredites, or sacred scholars, are Arathi dedicated to studying the Sacred Flame through unique discipline or craft. Some study the flame through scripture and prayer. Others study it from a more practical, hands-on perspective by working it into their craft, whether it be weapons, armaments, or technology. They spend a lot of time studying within the halls of the Priory of the Sacred Flame, though they will occasionally go out and fly their airships as close to Beledar as they can to observe it up close for study.

A safe spot (also known as an evade spot, terrain exploit, or pathing exploit) is a location in the game world where mobs are unable to reach a player due to unintended pathing behavior. When a player attacks or interacts with enemies from such a position, the NPCs may fail to navigate to the player, repeatedly evade, or become stuck. Blizzard classifies the use of safe spots as an exploit, and modern versions of World of Warcraft include systems that detect and punish this behavior. Some of the well-known safe spots include locations in the Zul'Farrak dungeon. Due to anti mechanics being implemented to combat boosting, mobs can be teleported directly to the player which prevents safe spots.

It was originally obtained by purchasing the Epic Edition of until 19 August 2025. After a brief cast time, using the toy will immediately mount the character upon the vehicle and permit the use of it's three abilities.

Sanctified Alloy is a bar crafting reagent made with Khaz Algar Blacksmithing. Blacksmiths with 25 skill points or more in Khaz Algar Blacksmithing can learn the ability to make this item from Darean in Dornogal for . 2 are created at a time.
Sand Swoopers are nether rays located in the desert of the central island of K'aresh.

Saradi is an earthen located at the Councilward's Rise in Dornogal and in Gundargaz in the Ringing Deeps. She is described as an earthen of few words. She serves Merrix as a clerk and was sent to fetch the adventurer to speak with Merrix after reading documents about Steelvein. She was privy to the fact of Merrix being Steelvein. She briefly accompanied Dawn in Foundation Hall as she set out to the expedition to the Siren Isle.
The Sapphire Enclave is a located in Valdrakken. The area is mostly inhabited by members of the blue dragonflight and features their motifs.

Sando the Rat is a hobgoblin located upstairs in the Incontinental Hotel during Liberation of Undermine. He trades one Counterfeit Dealer's Chip for weapon appearances from the raid. Two chips are statically awarded at Renown 11 and 15 with the Gallagio Loyalty Rewards Club, and additional chips drop from the One-Armed Bandit as personal loot at or above Renown 15. All but two weapons come in four cartel variants, with Venture Co. matching the Raid Finder appearance, Bilgewater for Normal, Blackwater for Heroic, and Darkfuse for Mythic.

Sargerei Missives are located in the Shattrath City Center and at the Sha'tar Way Station in Talador. Posted by the Sargerei, these notes can be burned during Assault on the Heart of Shattrath. Burning 30 of them awards Poor Communication.
Satyrweed Tincture is created by using a Field Medicine Kit on 3 Satyrweed Samples. Use it on a Thunderhead Hippogryph with to receive Rune of the Moon Goddess.

__NOTOC__ The Scale of Awakening comes in the form of two items: *a variant that can be purchased from Iszinormi (visage form) that can upgrade the Nasz'uro, the Unbound Legacy for evokers. *a variant that can be purchased from Iszinormi (dragon form) that can upgrade the Fyr'alath the Dreamrender for warriors, paladins, and death knights. Both scales cost 2x Antique Bronze Bullion from the vendors. It will upgrade the legendaries to ilvl 502 with an upgrade track for additional upgrades with Awakened Crests and Flightstones.

The Scalecracker Peaks are an area found in the Waking Shores, north of Scalecracker Keep. It consists of steep peaks and cliffsides, containing little wildlife and only a few trees on the northern slopes. Lava pools and flows are plentiful, and within one can be found an Empowered Snail which can be used to obtain a Magmashell mount.

One buff can be obtained every few hours by requesting a fortune and answering some questions from Sayge at the fairgrounds, with the answers given determining the specific buff received. Sayge's fortunes are considered world buffs and may be removed by the game upon entering an instance. The buff is not removed immediately upon logging out, but it expires in real time its duration continues ticking down while logged out or playing a different character. Scorchsong Isle is small island located in the Saltfang Shoals on the southwestern shore of Razorwind Shores. It's equipped for gatherings and events, featuring a bonfire, a small stage area, a flower-adorned archway, and multiple seating areas. Zin'nin sells alcohol in the central area.
